subject: Launchpad accelerator — cohort credit pool + onboarding waiver
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@launchpad.vc>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot credits for Feb cohort (Cohort 24)

Hi Michael,

Quick intro — I run the Launchpad Accelerator program and we have Cohort 24 kicking off in March (~120 founders). We loved Redwood from the demo; a lot of cohorts need low-latency inference for prototyping and we'd like to offer each team some starter credits as part of the program.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a cohort promotional package (credits + onboarding support) that we can attach to our acceptance emails? Budget is tight for many of the founders, so we’re looking for either a pooled credit model (we distribute credits from one pool) or a per-team allocation.

Two constraints to be aware of:
- We need a single PO and master agreement for the program (Launchpad issues a PO to the vendor)
- Legal needs a simple SOW/addendum and DocuSign-ready paperwork — we like fast turnarounds

What would you propose for a 120-team cohort? Any flexibility on converting unused credits to account credits for 3–6 months? Also could we get a short discount on committed capacity for selected portfolio companies if they convert to paid within 90 days?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Program Director, Launchpad Accelerator
elena@launchpad.vc

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@launchpad.vc>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for Feb cohort (Cohort 24)

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and congrats on Cohort 24. We can absolutely support a program-level package. Two fast options we typically use: 

Option A — Cohort pool (recommended for large cohorts)
- Single prepaid credit pool distributed by Launchpad admin.
- Suggested pool: $36,000 total (equivalent to ~$300 per team for 120 teams).
- 90-day validity for teams; unused credits can be rolled to the cohort account for up to 6 months (we can carve an exception here).
- Includes two onboarding workshops (recorded) and 3 office hours with our Solutions team.

Option B — Focused convert-to-paid pathway
- Smaller pool ($18,000) + 20% introductory discount on first 6 months for teams that convert within 90 days.
- Includes 5 dedicated onboarding credits for portfolio companies that show early traction.

I'll attach a short proposal and an SOW stub for legal to review. If you want to proceed we can: 1) create a draft SOW, 2) issue a DocuSign link, 3) once signed issue promo codes and schedule onboarding.

Attachments: Launchpad_Cohort_Pricing_Proposal_v1.pdf; SOW_launchpad_cohort_draft.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890 (deal RDW-ACC-2027-014)

If you'd like, I can pull Ben and Marissa into threads for discount/onboarding approvals.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Soto <elena@launchpad.vc>

Date: 2027-02-15T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for Feb cohort (Cohort 24)

Thanks Michael — Option A sounds closest to what we want but a few asks from our side:

- Could we reduce the total pool to $30k and instead add 6 collective onboarding sessions (so we don't distribute per-team onboarding)?
- Can unused credits be converted into account credits for each team for up to 6 months, rather than expiring strictly at 90 days?
- We will issue a single PO to Redwood and need a clean SOW + DocuSign. Contracts will be copied to contracts@launchpad.vc.

If you can get back with a revised SOW reflecting the $30k pooled credit and the extended rollover language, I can fast-track legal. We can also do a short 15m call tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this would be a great benefit for our founders.

—Elena

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Launchpad's ask. Key points: cohort of ~120, they want a $30k pooled credit with extended 6-month rollover on unused credits and 6 cohort-wide onboarding sessions (no per-team onboarding). They will issue a PO and expect a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Why this matters: large topline exposure and strong GTM partner — we get logo + co-marketing, and potential expansion into several portfolio companies.

Asks: 
- Ben: can we approve a $30k promo pool with 10% discount on any subsequent committed spend (they asked about 20% but I recommended we start lower)? Any required guardrails (cap on rollover, expiry)?
- Marissa: can CS commit to 6 cohort workshops + 2 follow-up office hours? Rough estimate of effort so I can include in SOW.

I've attached the initial proposal and SOW draft. If possible, please reply with approval or changes by EOD so I can send the updated SOW to Elena.

Michael — I'm okay with a modified exception, limited by a few guardrails:

- Approve a $25,000 cohort credit pool (not $30k) as a pilot.
- Allow rollover of up to 50% of unused credits to individual team accounts for up to 6 months.
- Approve 6 cohort workshops + 2 office hours (Marissa to confirm exact resourcing).
- In lieu of a 20% discount, offer a 10% discount on first 6 months for teams that convert to paid within 90 days.
- Require Launchpad to agree to a 6-month minimum committed capacity for up to 5 portfolio companies (e.g., $1k/month each) in order to unlock the pool — this protects revenue.

If Marissa confirms resourcing and legal can sign a simple SOW amendment, we can proceed. Also request to include a co-marketing mention: "Launchpad cohort powered by Redwood."

Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick responses and patience while we aligned internally. Summary of agreed pilot terms below (attached v2 of proposal & SOW):

- Cohort credit pool: $25,000 prepaid, administered by Launchpad (promo pool).
- Rollover: up to 50% of unused pool can be converted to per-team account credits and valid for up to 6 months.
- Onboarding: 6 cohort-wide workshops + 2 office hours with Solutions (Marissa to schedule).
- Conversion incentive: 10% discount on first 6 months for teams that convert within 90 days.
- Revenue protection: Launchpad agrees to use best efforts to surface up to 5 portfolio companies for a 6-month minimum commitment (~$1k/mo each); this will be noted in the SOW as a commercial goodwill commitment (not an invoice-level obligation).
- Legal & PO: we'll send a DocuSign-ready SOW and a short amendment; please confirm billing contact and PO timing (you mentioned Feb 25 target).
